Christian Hong

PhD in Applied Mathematics

About me

I earned my Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics at UC Santa Barbara in 2026 under Gustavo Ponce and Hector D. Ceniceros. Here is my CV. You can reach me via email at christianhong@math.ucsb.edu.

My research is focused on studying partial differential equations (PDEs), with an emphasis on dispersive systems derived from fluid mechanics. I also study the application of machine learning methods to soft materials.
